findings.title: Default update-strategy tests never enable rolling-updates
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns immediately when updateStrategy is null, and the new spec.features.enabled: rolling-updates assignment is only reached for an explicit strategy. The parameterized cases include null, which is the default "mimic 26.1" path: testImageChange(null) and testCacheMaxCount(null) deploy a CR without the feature. The operator guide added in this PR says the operator fails unless rolling-updates is enabled, and those tests still assert recreate/rolling status. As written, the default-strategy cases either fail reconciliation or only pass because some other image build happens to bake the feature in, so they do not actually cover the configuration users are told to use.

findings.title: Exit-code contract is not asserted
findings.body: This change makes exit status the public contract: recreate incompatibility moves from 4 to 3, and a disabled rolling-updates feature must exit 4. testFeatureNotEnabled only checks the error string, and testWrongVersions only checks the incompatibility message. Neither asserts result.exitCode(). That gap already hid the previous mismatch (code returned 4 while the guide documented 3), so a regression of 0/3/4 will still leave CI green and break scripts that branch on the exit code.
